scope: One Vite client build: emitted uncompressed UTF-8 JS and asset bytes; excludes this report itself. No gzip, network transfer, runtime timing, or production approval is inferred.
attribution: Route facade/module IDs and Rollup static/dynamic import edges. TinyRobot detection uses rendered @opentiny/tiny-robot[-kit] module IDs; code prebundled inside an unrelated module cannot be separately attributed.
byteAccounting: Closures count each emitted JS chunk once. Shared chunks appear in each dependent route and must not be summed across routes. Dynamic totals are separate from route static totals.

initialDependencies.basis: application entry static closure plus this selected route; other route dynamic imports are excluded
